title: AP2 core science test: Key Stage 3 (30 marks)
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 46 (AP2 core science test (30 marks) and mark scheme (portal))
intro: Lesson 46. 35 minutes. Answer every question. Show working and units.

questions.q: Name the organelle where photosynthesis happens.
Write the word equation for aerobic respiration.
Explain why the small intestine has villi.
questions.a: They give a large surface area (1) for absorbing digested food (1)

questions.q: In a food chain grass → rabbit → fox, what happens to the fox population if rabbits die out? Explain.
questions.a: It falls (1) because foxes lose their food (1)

questions.q: Give two differences between plant and animal cells.
questions.a: Plant cells have a cell wall, chloroplasts and a permanent vacuole (any two)

questions.q: Name the type of variation shown by height.
What is the formula of water and how many atoms does it contain?
Write the word equation for zinc reacting with hydrochloric acid.
questions.a: Zinc + hydrochloric acid → zinc chloride + hydrogen
A lit splint (1) gives a squeaky pop (1)

questions.q: Put in order of reactivity, most reactive first: copper, magnesium, iron.
Explain why alloys are harder than pure metals.
questions.a: Different-sized atoms (1) disrupt the layers so they cannot slide easily (1)

questions.q: What is the pH of a strong acid?
Calculate the speed of a car that travels 150 m in 10 s.
A wave has speed 12 m/s and frequency 4 Hz. Calculate its wavelength.
A 2 kW heater runs for 3 hours. Calculate the energy used in kWh.
Explain why we see lightning before we hear thunder.
questions.a: Light travels much faster than sound

questions.q: Name the two forces acting on a skydiver falling at constant speed and compare them.
questions.a: Weight and air resistance (1); they are equal (balanced) (1)
